name: The First Italian Campaign
summary: Bonaparte takes the Army of Italy at twenty-six and spends a year beating an Austrian army that outnumbers him every time it comes down out of the Alps — by never letting the whole of it arrive at once. Three afternoons of it: the everyday one, the one the ground decides, and the one that ends the war in Italy.

name: The Hundred Days
summary: Napoleon is back from Elba with an army raised in ten weeks, and two allied armies in Belgium that between them outnumber him half again. He has to beat them separately or not at all, and he has four days to do it. This is the second of those days, at a crossroads nobody had thought worth a name until it turned out that whoever held it could reach the other man's battle.

name: Drills
summary: Not history. Ground built to ask one question at a time, so that a rule can be watched somewhere nothing else is happening.
